content_of_post_to_comment:
My observation is that my mind starts thinking about other stuff i used to enjoy. I looked at Steam games a lot. I remembered playing Age Of Empires. I remembered a few other old games. I remembered old YT videos i watched 10 years ago. I remembered a bunch of other details from the past.

Something about keeping out modern YT makes my mind go back and remember the things i used to truly enjoy and wonder if i can enjoy them again today. I also looked around other hobbies and stuff, i did not found anything yet.

I hear that addiction is a narrowing of interests. And i feel like my interests are expanding a little.
